prompt: A multi-tenant document API has completed its authorization implementation. Run security verification in the supplied disposable environment. Tenant A has users `a-editor` and `a-viewer`; tenant B has `b-editor`; each tenant owns one document whose identifier is intentionally known to the other test tenant. Build an allow/deny matrix for list, read, rename, and delete. Confirm normal same-tenant operations allowed by the documented roles, then directly request tenant-B object identifiers while authenticated as tenant-A users and prove every cross-tenant read or mutation is denied at the API boundary. Also test unauthenticated access and a revoked `a-editor` session. After every denied mutation, read the database and queued side-effect table through the independent test-admin channel to prove no title change, deletion, export job, or other mutation occurred. Inspect response bodies and audit records for object-data/token leakage while confirming required denial audit events are present. UI visibility is not evidence.

requirements: the target is a disposable API instance containing only synthetic tenant and document data
tenant A and tenant B test identities plus same-tenant allowed controls are provisioned
the test-admin channel can read durable document state, queued side effects, and sanitized audit events independently from the normal API
one tenant-A editor session can be revoked deterministically before its negative case

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The evidence matrix includes allowed same-tenant controls and denied unauthenticated, revoked-session, wrong-role, and same-role cross-tenant object cases for the relevant operations.
Independent database and side-effect reads prove every denied cross-tenant or revoked mutation leaves protected state unchanged and creates no queued privileged work.

Required security audit events exist for denied sensitive operations while response/audit evidence does not disclose protected document content, bearer/session secrets, or another tenant's sensitive fields beyond the declared policy.

evidence: horizontal and vertical boundaries are distinguished rather than inferred from one denial
server enforcement and durable non-effects matter more than hidden UI affordances
the verdict reports untested role/object combinations rather than claiming universal isolation

requiredEvidence: explicit unavailable or simulated evidence labels
